metadata.title: Tabakly | Save good food, save money
metadata.description: Tabakly is developing a platform to help Ankara food businesses offer suitable surplus food to nearby consumers at more affordable prices.

hero.description: Tabakly is developing a platform to help bakeries, cafés, pastry shops, and restaurants make suitable surplus food available to students and nearby customers at more affordable prices.
hero.imageAlt: A bakery worker preparing a bag of assorted bread

problem.title: Too much good food is left unsold.
problem.description: At the end of the day, food businesses can be left with suitable products that are difficult to sell in time, while many people are looking for more affordable ways to enjoy quality food.

items.title: Short selling windows
items.description: Fresh products may have only a limited time to find another customer.

items.title: Everyday affordability
items.description: Students and nearby consumers want useful options that fit their budgets.

items.title: A missing connection
items.description: Businesses and consumers need a simple, clear way to find one another at the right time.

model.title: Saving food can be simple.
model.description: Tabakly is being designed to make suitable surplus food easier for businesses to offer and easier for nearby customers to discover.

steps.title: Businesses Share Surplus Food
steps.description: Participating food businesses could list suitable products with a clear price, collection time, and the information customers need.

steps.title: Customers Discover Nearby Offers
steps.description: Customers could browse affordable options from local bakeries, cafés, pastry shops, restaurants, and similar businesses.

steps.title: Reserve, Pick Up & Reduce Waste
steps.description: Customers could choose an offer and collect it from the business within the stated pickup window.

model.stageNote: Tabakly is currently being developed and validated in Ankara. The final workflow may evolve before launch.

benefits.title: Value for businesses and consumers.
benefits.description: The proposed platform is designed to create a practical connection around suitable surplus food.

businesses.label: For food businesses
businesses.title: Recover More, Waste Less
points: Reduce avoidable food waste and spoilage
Recover value from eligible surplus products
Make end-of-day offers easier to manage

consumers.label: For consumers
consumers.title: Save More, Waste Less
points: Access quality food at more affordable prices
Discover nearby bakeries, cafés, and other food businesses
Choose offers with clear pickup information
Support local businesses and lower-waste habits

survey.title: Take a short survey.
survey.description: The surveys help us validate the solution and understand what food businesses and consumers need before Tabakly launches.

businesses.label: For food businesses
businesses.title: Food Business Survey
businesses.description: Share how you currently manage surplus food and what would make Tabakly useful in your daily operation.

consumers.label: For consumers
consumers.title: Consumer Survey
consumers.description: Tell us what matters when choosing affordable surplus-food offers from nearby businesses.

privacy.title: Clear information before you share anything.
privacy.description: Before an external survey collects responses, Tabakly will provide the relevant information about the survey provider, purpose, data use, retention, and participant rights.
privacy.status: This website does not collect survey answers directly. Approved survey links and their privacy notices will be provided through the survey cards.

footer.description: Tabakly is developing a simpler way for food businesses and nearby consumers to make better use of suitable surplus food.
footer.contactDescription: Questions, partnerships, or feedback? Get in touch with the Tabakly team.
